macros.name: cds
macros.doc: The formatting commands \cfmt and \efmt (and their display style counterparts \cds and \eds) attempt to format the special cases of 1 and -1, as they appear in an exponent (the ‘e’ variations) and as they appear as a coefficient (the ‘c’ variations).

macros.name: cfmt
macros.doc: The formatting commands \cfmt and \efmt (and their display style counterparts \cds and \eds) attempt to format the special cases of 1 and -1, as they appear in an exponent (the ‘e’ variations) and as they appear as a coefficient (the ‘c’ variations).

macros.name: defineDepQJS
macros.doc: This command is used to define a new RV as a rational function of other RVs, and to define special JavaScript formatting, \js.

macros.name: dOf
macros.doc: \dOf{\⟨name⟩} is the denominator for the number \⟨name⟩.

macros.name: ds
macros.doc: \ds{\⟨name⟩} allows for special formatting for display style number.

macros.name: eds

macros.name: efmt

macros.name: fmt
macros.doc: \fmt{\⟨name⟩} allows for special formatting for in-line numbers.

macros.name: gcd
macros.doc: The greatest common divisor command \gcd takes two integers as its arguments and returns its result in the macro \thegcd.

macros.name: nOf
macros.doc: \nOf{\⟨name⟩} is the numerator for the number \⟨name⟩.

macros.name: RandomI
macros.doc: The command \RandomI defines a list of integers, {1,2,3...n} and randomly selects an integer, thought of as an index value, from the list.

macros.name: RandomL
macros.doc: The command \RandomL defines a list of numbers (integer, rational, decimal), and randomly selects a number from the list.

macros.name: RandomL
macros.doc: The command \RandomL defines a list of numbers (integer, rational, decimal), and randomly selects a number from the list.

macros.name: RandomP
macros.doc: The command \RandomP defines a list of strings (literal expressions), and randomly selects one from the list.

macros.name: RandomP
macros.doc: The command \RandomP defines a list of strings (literal expressions), and randomly selects one from the list.

macros.name: RandomS
macros.doc: The command \RandomS generates a random sign, either + or -.

macros.name: RandomS

macros.name: reduceFrac
macros.doc: \reduceFrac takes two arguments (numerator and denominator), both integers, and attempts to reduce the implied fraction to lowest terms, and returns the result in two macros \rfNumer and \rfDenom.

macros.name: RNGprintf
macros.doc: The \RNGprintf command uses the Acrobat JavaScript function util.printf. The argument of \RNGprintf is passed to util.printf as its formatting string.

macros.name: typeOf
macros.doc: You can determine the type of a RV with the \typeOf command, which takes a RV as its argument, the value of \typeOf is a nonnegative integer.

envs.name: writeRVsTo
